svg.title: 满盘之后，水只流向首个更大直径
svg.metadata: {"version":1,"title":"满盘之后，水只流向首个更大直径","steps":[{"caption":"从 1 号倒入 6；实际后继链是 1→2→5。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"amounts":[0,0,0,0,0],"remaining":6}},{"caption":"1 号装下 2，剩下 4 流向更大直径的 2 号。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"amounts":[2,0,0,0,0],"remaining":4}},{"caption":"2 号再装 3；3、4 号直径都较小，被完全跳过。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"amounts":[2,3,0,0,0],"remaining":1}},{"caption":"剩下 1 在 5 号停留，答案 5。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"amounts":[2,3,0,0,1],"remaining":0}},{"caption":"另一份独立询问重新从空盘开始，倒入 5。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"amounts":[0,0,0,0,0],"remaining":5}},{"caption":"1、2 号恰好装满 5，水停在 2 号；不能跳到 5 号。","image":"data:image/svg+xml;base64,","duration":2100,"facts":{"amounts":[2,3,0,0,0],"remaining":0}}]}

g.font-family: Microsoft YaHei, Noto Sans CJK SC, sans-serif
g.text: 满盘之后，水只流向首个更大直径
跳两盘的容量和是 2+3=5，只在 5 < 剩余水量 时接受。
3、4 号始终未接到水；每次询问的水量独立。
